GREEN AND DIGITAL UNIVERSITIES FOR SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT OF KYRGYZSTAN (GREEN KG)
Coordinator: Diplomatic Academy of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic named after Kazy Dikambaev

Project objective: The national project "Green and Digital University" is seamlessly aligned with the European Green Deal and the national strategy for raising environmental awareness, as well as developing and adapting a green and sustainable approach system in higher education institutions. The project aims to address the needs of universities to expand knowledge and institutional capacity in developing and implementing green and digital university policies.

Project Description: The "Green and Digital University" model, with the support and approval of the Ministry of Education of the Kyrgyz Republic, can be implemented at the national level to enhance the educational and innovation potential of Kyrgyz universities through the adoption of green policies and digitalization to foster their sustainable, inclusive growth and competitiveness. The Green University model will include the creation of Green Digital Offices (GDO) to implement a smart management concept aimed at minimizing negative environmental impact, managing university operations through energy and resource conservation, and promoting green ideas within society.

BSU Opens a Green and Digital Office: Heading Toward Sustainable Development

Bishkek State University has taken another step toward the future by joining a global sustainable development initiative. The university held the grand opening of a unique Digital and Green Office, established as part of a national project GREEN KG – Green and Digital Universities for Sustainable Development of Kyrgyzstan, implemented with the support of the Erasmus+ program.

The opening ceremony brought together prominent representatives of academia, BSU Rector Abdylda Musaev, faculty, students, and guests. Combining cutting-edge digital technologies with environmental initiatives, the new space sparked genuine interest and became a symbol of the university’s innovative approach to education.

The Digital and Green Office is not just an office space, but a comprehensive hub of opportunities for development. It will host digital literacy courses, sustainable development training, and classes on implementing green technologies. Plans also include organizing professional retraining programs and providing training on modern tools to implement eco-friendly and high-tech projects.

The university takes particular pride in its participation in the large-scale international Erasmus+ program, which brings together 10 universities in Kyrgyzstan alongside partners from Hamburg University and Vilnius University.

BSU faculty members have already completed 14 specialized training sessions in Hamburg, Vilnius, and Cholpon-Ata, enabling the university to adopt best practices in sustainable development. University Rector Abdylda Musaev noted: "The opening of the Digital and Green Office is not just an event. It is a challenge that we have embraced with confidence and inspiration. We are not only strengthening our university's position as a leader in the education system, but also shaping a future where ecology and technology go hand in hand."

The Digital and Green Office will serve as a platform for generating ideas, implementing environmental standards, and developing green competencies among students. Here, projects aimed at improving ecological and economic systems, protecting the environment, and combating climate change will be developed and implemented.

This opening symbolizes a new chapter in the history of BSU and reflects the university's commitment to the values of sustainable development. Bishkek State University looks to the future with confidence, becoming not only an educational center but also an innovation hub shaping the green and digital economy of tomorrow.
We are proud of this achievement and thank everyone who contributed to the implementation of the project. Ahead lie new horizons, ambitious goals, and confident steps toward achieving them.
